comparison.objective: Open a panel held by a spring-return plunger.
comparison.physical_skill: Hold a spring knob retracted with one hand while pulling a hinged panel clear with the other.
comparison.success_condition: Panel opens ≥37°; damage or fixture movement fails. Timing of release and hands-clear behavior is not scored.
comparison.reason: Tests simultaneous bimanual release-and-open timing, not adjustment locking or iterative dynamic commissioning.
